name: Vairengte–Kolasib State Highway
significance: SH 40, Vairengte–Kolasib State Highway, crosses the border between Assam and Mizoram. A state road that runs through more than one state has no single owner — Assam PWD (Roads) and Mizoram PWD each maintain the stretch inside their own state, so which department to contact depends on where along the road you are.
